faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available for the Private Secretary post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the post of Private Secretary at IISER Kolkata as per the official recruitment notification released for 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IISER Kolkata recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application and the hard copy of the application form at IISER Kolkata is 21 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Private Secretary position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for candidates applying for the Private Secretary position at IISER Kolkata is 38 years as of the crucial date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General candidates?
faq.answer: The application fee for General / Unreserved category candidates is ₹500/-. Candidates should pay this fee through the prescribed online payment mode.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for this post?
faq.answer: The selection process involves three stages: shortlisting of online applications, a qualifying Skill/Trade Test, and a final Written Test carrying 100 marks.

faq.question: Q6. Is there a hard copy submission requirement?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates are required to send the hard copy of the downloaded PDF of the filled application form along with self-attested testimonials to the institute by the specified deadline.

faq.question: Q7. What is the required computer speed for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a computer key depression speed equivalent to 60 words per minute to be eligible for the Private Secretary post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary scale for the Private Secretary?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Private Secretary post will be placed in Pay Level-7 as per the 7th Central Pay Commission (CPC) guidelines.

faq.question: Q9. Is experience mandatory for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have at least 5 years of relevant experience in Government organizations in Pay Level-6 or above to be eligible for the post.

faq.question: Q10. Where should the hard copy of the application be sent?
faq.answer: The hard copy must be sent to The Dean (Administration), Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Kolkata, Mohanpur, Nadia District, Pin – 741246, superscribed with the post name.
